name: wuyin-composer
description: 五音堂 — 以宫商角徵羽为主旋律批量创作。iOS / Android / 手表 / 智能戒指手杖

scripts.start: npm run build && npx --yes serve www -p 5188
scripts.sync:android: npm run build && npx cap sync android
scripts.sync:ios: LANG=en_US.UTF-8 LC_ALL=en_US.UTF-8 npm run build && LANG=en_US.UTF-8 LC_ALL=en_US.UTF-8 npx cap sync ios
scripts.mobile:android: npm run sync:android && npm run open:android
scripts.mobile:ios: npm run sync:ios && npm run open:ios
scripts.apk: npm run sync:android && cd android && node ../../tools/run-gradle-android.mjs assembleDebug
scripts.test:all: npm run test:unit && npm run test:ab && npm run test:completeness && npm run test:robustness && npm run test:security && npm test
